title: A freeze check that exits early after it started stays Pending and tells the reviewer to wait forever
outcome: A recorded freeze check that exits after begin_review_input_check without running to an outcome (the current_exe() failure, or the post-run authority re-check failing on an unchanged attempt) records Unavailable for its sequence, so the reviewer is told to repeat the check rather than to wait for one that will never finish.
acceptance: Both early exits in verify_review_freeze_with_commands after begin_review_input_check record Unavailable for that check's sequence when the attempt is unchanged; a regression test shows the refusal is [identity-checker-unavailable] (repeat the same check), not [identity-check-pending].
